生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven, Ally Soldier, SOLDIERS,
ROAD TO HOME VILLAGE, HOME/VILLAGE,
and battle final-frame references.

Keep the same character identities, faces, costumes, weapons,
and environment.

The provided battle final-frame establishes the situation:

Riven and Ally are allies.

They are together at the CENTER of a large circle of enemy SOLDIERS.

The SOLDIERS surround both of them from every direction.

Riven and Ally fight the surrounding SOLDIERS together.

Riven and Ally never attack each other.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Late sunset.

Grounded realistic sword combat.

Natural physical movement.

Natural English dialogue and lip sync.

Simple cinematic camera movement.

Keep the action clear and continuous.

No graphic gore.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== SCENE ===

Begin much closer than the provided battle final-frame.

A SOLDIER passes close across the foreground.

As he clears the frame, reveal Riven and Ally together
at the center of the surrounding army.


Riven and Ally stay close together and hold their ground.

The SOLDIERS attack them continuously from different directions.

The attacks come in waves.

One SOLDIER moves in.

Riven or Ally forces him back.

Another SOLDIER immediately moves in from another direction.

Riven and Ally keep defending themselves together.

Neither of them is winning easily.

They are simply trying to survive and hold their position
inside the overwhelming encirclement.


During this crowded fight,
Riven is fully occupied fighting one SOLDIER directly in front of her.

She blocks his attacks and fights back.

Her attention remains completely on this opponent.


At the same moment,
another SOLDIER approaches Riven from her exposed side.

Riven does not see him.

He raises his sword and swings directly toward Riven.


Ally sees the incoming attack.


He immediately shouts:

"RIVEN!"


Riven hears him,
but she is still occupied with the SOLDIER in front of her.


Ally reacts instantly.

He throws his own body between Riven
and the incoming sword strike.


The sword strike hits Ally instead of Riven.


Ally has deliberately taken the attack meant for Riven.


ONLY ALLY is hit.

Riven is unharmed.

The other SOLDIERS remain standing around them.


Ally loses his strength.

Riven immediately catches him as he collapses.


Keep the camera close to Riven and Ally.

The surrounding SOLDIERS remain in the background.

Do not focus on them.


Riven holds Ally in her arms.

She looks at him in shock.


Riven quietly asks:

"Why?"


Ally looks at her weakly.

He answers:

"You would've done the same."


Ally dies in Riven's arms.


Riven remains holding him.


After a quiet moment,
Riven slowly looks far across the valley.


In the distance,
thick dark smoke and orange fire rise
from the direction of her home village.


Riven stares at the distant fire in shock and grief.


Then she slowly looks back down at Ally.


Riven carefully lowers Ally onto the ground.


She remains beside him.

CUT.、16:9
